correctness.rationale: The finite-discrete definitions reduce RP to pair mergeability and RP-minus to images of diagonal. Relations a^2=a, ab^2=b^2a, aba=a and b^(2m)=id establish exactly 6m distinct transformations (2m permutations plus 4m rank-m maps). Their two distinct fiber matchings yield C_(2m), and a unique nonmergeable pair on three points would be forward invariant, excluding minimality. One generator is a cyclic permutation under finite minimality. Independently executed verifier checks the algebra for m=2..16 and the complete two-letter n=2,3 census; infinite conclusions rest on proof.
